entry.title: v5.6.8
entry.content:
What's Changed

  • Fix table column alignment on nested layouts by @contributor01 in #10001
  • Fix repeater reordering losing focus by @contributor02 in #10002
  • Fix select search debounce on multiple mode by @contributor03 in #10003
  • Fix notification body overflow on small screens by @contributor04 in #10004
  • Fix wizard step validation skipping hidden fields by @contributor05 in #10005
  • Fix infolist entry alignment in split layout by @contributor06 in #10006
  • Fix action modal not closing after redirect by @contributor07 in #10007
  • Fix global search keyboard navigation wrap by @contributor08 in #10008
  • Fix file upload preview memory leak by @contributor09 in #10009
  • Fix table bulk action deselect after refresh by @contributor10 in #10010
  • Fix relation manager pagination reset by @contributor11 in #10011
  • Fix dark mode contrast on disabled buttons by @contributor12 in #10012
  • Fix date picker timezone drift by @contributor13 in #10013
  • Fix chart widget resize flicker by @contributor14 in #10014
  • Fix tenant switch losing query string by @contributor15 in #10015

Full Changelog: https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/compare/v5.6.7...v5.6.8

ENDOFCHANGELOG568
